subject: science
concept: Classifying organisms as producers, consumers, or decomposers
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Life Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Ecosystems) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts organism cards into producer, consumer, and decomposer piles
exercise.pictorial: Student matches an organism to its correct role in an ecosystem
exercise.abstract: Student explains why a given organism fits its classified role

misconception_flags: classifies decomposers as a type of consumer rather than their own distinct role

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
